To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the plasma-based wakefield accelerator experiment E-157 will be the first to demonstrate high-gradient acceleration of an electron beam in a plasma over a meter-long distance and that it will be the first plasma wakefield acceleration study of an electron beam with energy and charge comparable to those in a modern high-energy electron-positron collider.

(1) a 1 m long, high quality plasma can be produced at SLAC, (2) a single SLC bunch can induce wakefields of up to 1 GeV/m over the entire 1 m length, (3) the SLC bunch can be accelerated by 1 GeV over 1 m, and (4) a single bunch can be used to both drive the wakefields and to witness the acceleration.
